adapter: DSPy defaults during training (dspy.ChatAdapter with its default JSON fallback); trained programs are evaluated in chat-default-think and json-default-think
authorization: Owner in chat 2026-09-25: re-train the open models' prompts with default thinking ON, maximize vLLM throughput (shared servers), launch asap.
caches: a private DSPy cache per optimizer run during training only; every DEV/TEST evaluation of a trained program is a fresh generation with the response cache OFF (the historical mistake was evaluating on cached optimizer outputs).

data_split.dev: 21 DEV papers: never seen by any optimizer; used only to choose among trained configs with the grid pick rule
data_split.optimizer_validation: the other 20 TRAIN papers (fixed split, seed 9, recorded by paper ID before any run)
data_split.test: 29 TEST papers: final acceptance check against Opus (>= 290 of 365), reported for every config

evaluation: each finished program is evaluated like the grid (plan.json + amendments 1-4): DEV and TEST, formats chat-default-think and json-default-think, stages combined / verified (common Qwen verifier, thinking off) / filtered / noverify, arm pools (w16k+w32k, w8k+w16k+w32k); audited by the independent audit before scoring; one DEV-only pick across the whole grid + trained configs with the same rule.
metric: M3-full-v1 per paper, unchanged from the historical optimizers

optimizers.bootstrap: dspy.BootstrapFewShot, max_bootstrapped_demos=1, max_labeled_demos=0 (historical defaults), starting from the hand-written instruction
optimizers.gepa: dspy.GEPA score-only, metric M3-full-v1 paper-level, reflection LM = the same model with thinking ON at its default sampling, valset = optimizer_validation, max_metric_calls 300 (half the historical 600 because thinking multiplies cost)
optimizers.mipro: dspy.MIPROv2 auto=light, max 1 bootstrapped demo, no labeled demos, no data-aware proposer (historical settings), valset = optimizer_validation

parity_check: The audit publishes one table of reasoning mode, sampling, max tokens, adapter and windows for EVERY compared config, open and paid, and flags any difference between configs that are compared.
runs: 2 models x 3 optimizers x 3 window programs = 18 optimizer runs
serving: one vLLM server per model spanning a whole 4-GPU node (Qwen: data-parallel 2 x tensor-parallel 2; Gemma: data-parallel 4), prefix caching on, high max-num-seqs; all optimizer runs of that model share the server with high client concurrency. Fallback if data-parallel serving fails its startup check: independent servers per GPU group with client-side round-robin.
student_decoding: thinking ON exactly as plan-amendment-4 default-on (enable_thinking=true, model's own generation_config sampling, seed 9, 32,768 max_tokens, model reasoning parser)
time_limit: all optimizer runs stop by 2026-09-26 16:00 UTC so that nodes are free for the Sunday corpus run; a run stopped by the deadline returns its best program by optimizer_validation score (never by DEV) and is labelled 'stopped at deadline'. Runs checkpoint so a 24 h walltime or node failure can resume.
why: Every open-model prompt so far (Qwen GEPA, Gemma Bootstrap/MIPRO/GEPA, SOOFI) was optimized and evaluated with thinking disabled, while paid models used high reasoning. Prompts optimized without thinking may be wrong for thinking mode.

windows.w32k: 32,000/4,000 (w16k and w32k programs are combined as in arm C)
